content: Pino le taŋgo tuku pasa

Pino kame, tane taŋgine taŋgo kat taŋgine tuku miŋge kumnemŋge minap. Tane taŋamba minmba taŋgine taŋgo afu Kuate tuku pasa dubi ndakade ta tane pasa ande sa ndamba taŋgine ŋgan maŋau tambi nane Kuate dubiwam tuku didikamŋgaig.
Tane aleŋ aleŋ ndaka Kuate kumnemŋge minmba katesek maŋau ŋak minap le taŋgine taŋgo kat taŋgine nane maŋau ta kaŋgermba Kuate dubiwam tuku iduswaig.
Tane gabat waŋe mara mara pareŋ latomba mindepiymba tawi magenu tiŋmba taŋamba ŋgarosu tuku mindepiye suŋgomba idus ndawap.
Tane ŋgamuŋgal tuku mindepiye wamdus bafuknu ŋgan maŋau kile-mayokkap. Maŋau ta kugawe nda. Minmba minamŋgat. Kuate am mbolŋge suŋgokanu.
O buk pino kame Kuate dubimba nu minde minnaig mbal nane taŋamba ŋgamuŋgal tuku mindepiye ŋak minmba naŋgine taŋgo kat naŋgine kumnemŋge minnaig.
Tane Sara tuku maŋau kaŋgerap. Nu Abraham kumnemŋge minmba yiŋe gabat ŋga minna. Pino kame, tane wam ande tuku kuru kuru ndaka maŋau tiŋreknu ndo kap ta tane Sara tuku kulim kame minig.

Taŋgo kame, tane mata raŋgun mayenu ŋak taŋgine pino kame ndoŋ minap. Nane tane tuku saŋgri kumuŋ kuga tukunu nane kulat magekap. Kuate nu tale arŋeŋ ake sinaŋ make patikina le tale kumu kumu abo kitek tinaik. Ta tuku tane taŋgine pino kame kulat magekap. Kuate nu tane tuku yabaŋ pasa ise ndakikat.
Sine ŋgamuŋgal ulendi ŋak minbe
Ye wam pagu afu satiŋgamŋgit. Tane ŋakmba wamdus ndindo tap. Piti muŋgu turturkap. Taŋgine taŋgine kume purkap. Taŋgine nyu kile-mayok ndakap. Tane muŋgu sinakap.

Nane afu tane mbolŋge wam ŋaigonu kuwaig kande tane lafumba wam ŋaigonu ke ndakap. Ko nane afu tane tumail pantiŋguwaig kande tane lafumba tumail pan ndaniŋgap. Kuga. Tane lafumba nyaro mayenu niŋgap. Kuate nu tane wikina ta tane nyaro mayenu kilam tuku wikina.
Kuate tuku kuyar pasa teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ande nu nuŋe mine ŋakmba mbolŋge gare minam idusmba kande nu pasa ŋayonu ko yabri pasa ande sa ndakuwa.
Nu maŋau ŋaigonu kusreka wam magenu kumba minwa.
Nu nane ŋakmba ndoŋ ŋgamuŋgal mukuknu minam tuku wamdus saŋgrinu pilwa.
Nu nane tuku yabaŋ pasa isit.
Nu wam ŋaigonu kade mbal tuku ŋgueu minit. Mune 34.12-16

content: Kuate tuku pasa taŋamba sakate.
Sine maŋau tiŋreknu tuku rar tam kumuŋ
Tane wam magenu kam tuku wamdus saŋgrinu palpe ta ande nu tane kilmba ŋaigo siglike nda.
Ko afuŋge tane maŋau magenu kap le kilmba rar tiŋguwaig kande taŋaig. Kuate nu tane mbolŋge wam magenu kamŋgat. Tane taŋgo tuku wam idusmba kuru kuru ndakap.
Tane Kristus nu sine tuku Suŋgo ŋga nu kumnemŋge minap. Ande nu ndaŋam tane Kristus minde minig ŋga kusnatiŋguwa ndeta tane lafuwam ŋga nu idusmba pasa mukuk sawap.
Tane Kuate am mbolŋge mbar tuku piti kugatok minap. Tane taŋamba Kristus ndoŋ ulendika mine mayenu mbolŋge minig le afuŋge tane ŋgumnem pasa tiŋgig ta ŋgumnem pasa ta luka naŋgine kiko tuwaig.
Kuate nu nzaliwa le afuŋge tane maŋau tiŋreknu tuku rar tiŋguwaig kande maye. Tane mbarde ta tuku afuŋge rar tiŋguwaig ta ŋayo.
Kristus nu taŋgo tuku une saukam tuku kumna
Kristus mata mbar ndamba purfeŋnu minmba sine une ŋak mbal tuku kumna. Nu sine kilmba Kuate tugum prowam tuku taŋana. Nane nu tuku ŋgarosu balenaig ta nu nuŋe kanu mbolŋge abo ŋak mayok kina.
Nuŋe kanu kumba ka kanu afu muliŋ kilmba ndalekanu ma mbolŋge minnaig ta pasa niŋgina.

Muliŋ kilanu mbal ta nane Noa tuku ait mbolŋge nu waŋ kusmba minna le Kuate nu ŋgan minmba nane tairtairŋgina ta kuga. Nane nu tuku pasa ise ndakinaig. Taŋanaig le nane 8 ndo waŋ ta poŋginaig. Poŋginaig le kule taŋge waŋ tumba te-faitmba nane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋgina.

Kule pisne maŋau wam ndui ta ndo tane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgit. Ŋgarosu tuku kutur saukate le wam ta mbolŋge kuga. Kuate nu Yesus te-tina le tiŋgina tane wam ta tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋga taŋgine mbar tuku piti saukam tuku Kuate yabaŋmba kule pisne tade le muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgit.
Yesus nu tiŋgina sulumba samba mbol kumba kile nu Kuate tuku ndinam kumamŋge nyu suŋgo ŋak minit le eŋel kame guwa kise kise saŋgri ŋak ta ŋakmba nu kumnemŋge minig.
